verdict.rationale: Glama's hosted MCP Inspector lets users test arbitrary MCP servers from the browser, but that is an adjacent testing tool, not an isolated sandbox. The evidence states it is not an isolated sandbox of Glama's own API and that no test keys or isolation framing exist. The API reference's "Try it" panel runs against the production API with a real bearer key, so there is no documented way to test without touching production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
